description: Figure 3 is a line chart that illustrates the performance variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate on the HateXplain dataset. The chart displays three distinct lines, each representing one of the evaluation metrics: precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis, which is not explicitly labeled with values, represents the different model variants, including the full model (MS-FSLHate), and ablated versions such as w/o Prompt, w/o Augmentation, w/o Attention, and w/o Prompt & Augmentation. The y-axis, also unlabeled, represents the performance metric values in percentage. The line for precision starts at approximately 65.45% for the full model and shows a general downward trend, with the lowest value around 61.06% for the w/o Prompt variant. The recall line starts at 65.78% for the full model and also trends downward, reaching its lowest point at 56.82% for the w/o Prompt & Augmentation variant. The F1-score line begins at 65.56% for the full model and follows a similar downward trend, ending at 57.74% for the w/o Prompt & Augmentation variant. The chart visually demonstrates that the removal of key components from the model leads to a decrease in all three performance metrics, with the most significant drops observed in the w/o Prompt & Augmentation variant.
